transcript: Human: Mujhe woh pasand hai. [I like him.] AI: I like him. Human: Main usse pyaar karti hoon. [I love him.] AI: I love him. Human: Main usse shaadi karna chahti hoon. [I want to marry him.] AI: I want to marry him. Human: Pata nahi main kab aisi English bol paungi. [I don't know when I will be able to speak English like this.] AI: Don't worry. Mere saath roz aise 10-15 minute practice karoge toh aaram se seekh jaoge. [Don't worry. If you practice with me for 10-15 minutes daily like this, you will learn easily.] Human: Galat English bolne pe mujhe sharm aati hai. [I feel ashamed when I speak wrong English.] AI: Main ek AI teacher hoon. Na hi main tumhe judge karungi, na hi tumhara mazak udaungi. [I am an AI teacher. Neither will I judge you, nor will I make fun of you.] Human: Aur main aap se English kahan se seekh sakti hoon? [And where can I learn English from you?] AI: Tumhe zyada kuch nahi karna, bas English Seekho app download kar lo. Yeh ek English speaking seekhne ka app hai jahan mere jaise AI teachers tumhe roz English bolna aur practice karna sikhayenge. Aur 20 dinon mein tum English bolna seekh jaogi. [You don't have to do much, just download the English Seekho app. This is an English speaking learning app where AI teachers like me will teach you to speak and practice English daily. And in 20 days, you will learn to speak English.] Human: Phir toh yeh app mehanga bhi hoga na? [Then this app must be expensive, right?] AI: Mehanga nahi, sasta bolo. Sirf ek rupee ka trial le sakte ho. [Not expensive, say cheap. You can take a trial for just one rupee.] Human: Are! Mujhe pehle kyun nahi pata chala is app ke baare mein? Main abhi download karti hoon English Seekho app. [Oh! Why didn't I know about this app before? I am downloading the English Seekho app right now.] Voiceover: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, English Seekho kisi bhi government authority institution brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai... [English Seekho is not endorsed, sponsored, affiliated or associated with any government authority, institution, brand, organisation or individual...]
summary: A split-screen ad features a user practicing English translation with an AI avatar teacher. The AI reassures the user against the fear of judgment and promotes the English Seekho app. The ad highlights a 20-day learning promise and a 1-rupee trial offer, concluding with a call to install the app.
